feeds.title: Metal Detecting Life
feeds.description: My name is Ace. Metal Detecting Life is a blog where I aim to help both the would-be pirate and everyday treasure hunter so that no matter what category you fall under, I'll be able to answer your questions as well as help expand your metal detecting arsenal so that you can get more enjoyment and better finds out of this wonderful hobby.

feeds.title: Desert Roamer Press Blog
feeds.description: Learn about treasure hunting, gold, meteors, underwater finds, through the eyes of Greg Hawk. Greg Hawk is the president of Desert Roamer Press, an adventure travel publisher specializing in treasure hunting in the American Southwest.

feeds.title: Black Cat Treasure Hunts Blog
feeds.description: Find occasional updates, forthcoming events and latest news. Black Cat Treasure Hunts create personalised treasure hunts for teambuilding, hen parties, birthdays, anniversaries, special events, foreign students, re-unions etc.

feeds.title: Mr Treasure Hunt Blog
feeds.description: Mr Treasure Hunt builds fun and interactive scavenger hunt and treasure hunt events all over the San Francisco Bay Area! Dive into the latest blogs for news, upcoming events, and the exciting prospect of integrating AR into an event! Stay tuned for more updates.

feeds.title: One More Nut In The Road
feeds.description: Fun, strange, interesting, crazy, unusual, and totally unexpected treasures found every day on my run. From shiny pennies to sockets, lug nuts, wallets, cell phones, credit cards, tools to rubber duckies.

feeds.title: Treasure Hunters Blog
feeds.description: We sell top brand metal detectors and accessories. Lowest prices and fast tracked delivery to your door.

feeds.title: Beck Antiques Blog
feeds.description: I'm Clinton Beck. Welcome to my blog where we discuss all things relating to antiques and treasures. Beck Antiques & Jewelry is Edmonton's most unusual and incredible antique store. You will find historical artifacts, antique jewelry and appraisals.

feeds.title: Atlantic Treasure Club Blog
feeds.description: Atlantic Treasure Club is the oldest treasure hunting club in the tri state area.
